content.content: A verb handler returns its normal output as a list of stdout lines and never touches a stream. The envelope is the sole writer of both channels — the returned lines to stdout, the refusal to stderr — and the dispatch chain threads the handler's lines to it untouched.
content.rationale: xyoslvwo settles the split — verbs own their output lines, the substrate owns crossing boundaries — and wlyztxku/opmtpuzz fix stdout as the envelope's channel; writing is that crossing, so the envelope, not the verb, writes. Returning the lines rather than handing the handler a writer keeps a handler a plain fn and its output observable without a stream — the mirror of the Refusal it already returns.
